weeks.2: Allowable pressure: SPT and plate load
weeks.3: Settlement I: immediate and consolidation amount
weeks.4: Settlement II: stress at depth and consolidation time
weeks.5: Settlement III: secondary compression and CPT
weeks.12: Lateral earth pressure II: Coulomb, retaining walls

shallow.name: Which strength? (drained or undrained)
shallow.blurb: One soil, one strength law. Read the profile, choose drained or undrained from the loading speed (not the water table), then take c, φ, the unit weight and the N-factors.

shallow.name: Bearing capacity
shallow.blurb: Ultimate capacity q_f, factor of safety or required width: strip, square, water table, eccentric and inclined loads.

shallow.name: Allowable pressure from SPT
shallow.blurb: Correct the blow counts (overburden, dilatancy), average them over the influence depth, then read q_a for a settlement limit.

shallow.name: Plate load test
shallow.blurb: Scale a small plate's settlement up to the real footing.

shallow.name: Immediate (elastic) settlement
shallow.blurb: Elastic settlement with influence factors: layered clay, loaded areas split into rectangles.

shallow.name: Stress increase at depth
shallow.blurb: Vertical stress under a loaded rectangle with influence factors and superposition.

shallow.name: Void ratio and stress history
shallow.blurb: Final void ratio when the soil reloads: over-consolidated, crossing the pre-consolidation pressure, normally consolidated.

shallow.name: Consolidation settlement
shallow.blurb: One-dimensional settlement of a clay layer from its stress change (C_c, C_r, e_0, OCR).

shallow.name: Consolidation time
shallow.blurb: How long it takes: time factor, drainage path, scaling a lab sample or an earlier reading to the field.

shallow.name: Secondary compression
shallow.blurb: Creep after primary consolidation ends: C_alpha and the time ratio.

shallow.name: CPT / Schmertmann settlement
shallow.blurb: Settlement of sand from a cone profile: strain influence factor, E = 2.5 q_c, layer by layer.

shallow.name: Concept (multiple choice)
shallow.blurb: Recognise the idea behind the formula.

deep.name: Single pile in clay
deep.blurb: Alpha method for shaft resistance, N_c for the base.

deep.name: Single pile in sand
deep.blurb: Meyerhof from SPT, or beta from effective stress.

deep.name: Design the length L
deep.blurb: Find the pile length that carries a given load.

deep.name: Pile group
deep.blurb: n times P_u against the equivalent block; efficiency; allowable load.

deep.name: Pile settlement
deep.blurb: Elastic settlement of single piles and groups (Poulos factors).

walls.name: Rankine pressures
walls.blurb: K_a and K_p, pressure at each depth, surcharge, active behind and passive in front.

walls.name: Layers, water and thrust
walls.blurb: Layered soils, pore water, total thrust and the height of its line of action.

walls.name: Cohesive soil and tension cracks
walls.blurb: z₀ = 2c/(γ√K_a), critical depth 4c_u/γ, undrained (total stress) analysis.

walls.name: Sloping backfill
walls.blurb: K_a for a surface inclined at β; pressure parallel to the slope.

walls.name: Coulomb and wall friction
walls.blurb: Wall friction δ, wall adhesion, inclined wall back, trial wedge.

walls.name: Embedded walls and stability
walls.blurb: Cantilever sheet piles, factor of safety on strength and embedment; gravity wall overturning, sliding, bearing.
